title: Utilities Tab
subtitle: A Utilities tab with a Show menu, cost-by-month and year-over-year charts, and the bill history; utility payments file themselves as bills. One upgrade, then Claude loads your gas history.
intro: After the pull request merges, the code is already in your Sheet. The upgrade adds two tabs: Utilities, after Spending, and Utility Bills, the table it reads, after Recurring Payments.
**What does not change:** no rows, balances or entered values. Existing tab names and headers stay the same.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before Utilities tab`.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.
steps.note: The report should include "Added tab: Utility Bills" and "Added tab: Utilities".

steps.text: Tell Claude the upgrade is done. Claude loads your DTE gas bills into the Utility Bills tab.
steps.done: Utility Bills lists the gas bills, one row each, newest due on December 2 marked Due.

steps.text: Open **Finance Tracker → Bank feed → Sync now**. Utility payments already in Transactions, such as the Consumers Energy payment, are filed as paid bills.
steps.done: Utility Bills gains an Electric row for the Consumers Energy payment.

steps.text: Open **Utilities**. With Show set to **All utilities**, the cost-by-month chart has a line per utility and a dotted total; the tiles add everything up.
steps.done: The gas line climbs in winter and falls in summer.

steps.text: Change **Show** (cell B3) to **Gas**. The tiles, both charts and the bill history switch to gas alone. Switch back to All utilities when done.
steps.note: Water and more electric history arrive when you send those statements to Claude, or through Finance Tracker → Import from Claude.
